origin: between the feet, on the ground

clips.name: idle_alive
clips.use: Standing by: breathing, shifting weight, a look round, an ear flick, blinks.

clips.name: greet
clips.use: Notices the visitor, waves with the whole body, settles.

clips.name: walk
clips.use: Walk cycle in place: planted feet, hip sway, arms a beat behind the legs.

clips.name: haul_rope
clips.use: Leaning back, hand over hand on a rope, heels dug in. Beat 1: hauling the island in.

clips.name: pick_up
clips.use: Looks, squats, reaches with one hand, lifts with the legs, holds the find up to look at it.

clips.name: cheer
clips.use: Crouch, hop with both arms thrown up, land with a squash, one more pump, settle.

clips.name: take_rope
clips.use: Squats to the rope at his feet, takes it and straightens into the haul. Beat 1.

clips.name: tie_off
clips.use: Takes the rope twice round a post in front of him, hauls it tight, lets go. Beat 1.

clips.name: dust_hands
clips.use: Brushes his palms together, a pleased nod, arms drop. Beat 1.
